No news monday, no trades for me today. There were a couple of things to look at but overall price action was just a little choppy and not worth trading.
,

There were two potential entries after 10:00 and I didn’t bother with either of them. The first was a short basically straight away because of a 1min rb that was rejecting out of the nwog. That trade would most likely be a break even. and then the second one price comes back up to the level again. I think the only reason these trades would give a reaction are because of the NWOG cause there was nothing too strong about the 10:00 level today. (Screenshot 1)
,
PM session was slow, but it was a little more interesting because we had an external smt of asian lows, and then an internal smt with nyam lows. Those were really strong smt’s in my opinion, but entry trigger wise there wasn’t much there. There is a 5min cisd that I wouldn’t take but I’m just noting it for the smt. (Screenshot 2)
